title: Hooked on Africa Best of
description:
S02 E13 — Kruger Park
Join the team as they walk the majestic Sabi River in the iconic Kruger National Park and go in search of the Large Scale Yellow Fish. Accompanied by armed guards the team contends with the resident wildlife and catches up with a couple.

title: Hooked on Travel
description:
S01 E13 — The Kalahari
One of the oldest deserts in Africa isn't where you'd expect to find anglers prospecting, but the great Orange River, on the border of Namibia, has a treasure trove of fish. Tommo and Rhu hunt for the apex predator in this arid landscape.

title: Reel Africa
description:
S01 E13 — Bay of Kings
Join the crew as they take on the challenge of reeling in GTs in the legendary Bay of Kings, known for its breathtaking scenery and fierce marine predators.

title: Inside Angling
description:
S01 E02 — Mystic Waters
Our intrepid anglers are out to discover a new species of kingfish off the north coast of Madagascar. The trip to this magnificent island with so many unique species on offer is one fishing adventure they won't soon forget!

title: Wildfly Best of
description:
S02 E13 — The Slam
Every fly fisher yearns to complete a flats slam and in the tropical isles of Seychelles this is on the Menu every day. To catch a Kingfish; triggerfish and bonefish is the goal of the WildFly Team.
